narr: An intense supercell thunderstorm originated near Chugwater, Wyoming, during the early to mid afternoon hours on 6/20, tracking across southern Platte and Goshen counties through approximately 3:00 PM MDT before moving into the western Nebraska Panhandle. Storm chasers reported extremely large and destructive hail up to 4.5 inches in diameter along with wind gusts in excess of 70 MPH, noting that they had never seen that large of hail coinciding with such intense winds.
ev: A trained spotter reported County Road 205 underwater due to heavy rainfall.
lsr: Delayed report. Spotter reported County Road 205 underwater between 530 PM and 6PM.
